intro: Pilot Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot seeks samples of volatile incendicite ore discovered in the Wetlands. Believing its explosive properties could revolutionize artillery munitions, he tasks miners with venturing north to extract the dangerous mineral from a secluded cave.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate. Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!
Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.
Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining. If you don't have it, then... Bring a friend who does to that cave!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got the ore! Well done, friend! I'll get someone to work with this right away. Let's hope he doesn't blow himself up!
